data.description: The Electric Fuse is what you bring to monument puzzles, letting power through for a limited time. 16 monuments need one, such as Power Plant, [Train Yard](/monument/train-yard), [Launch Site](/monument/launch-site) and [Airfield](/monument/airfield), and those last two take 2. You can't craft or buy fuses, so loot them: Tier 2 Components crates in [Underwater Labs](/monument/underwater-lab) have a 26.53% chance at 1-2, Normal Crates and Underwater Advanced Crates 14.29%. Scientists rarely drop them, at 4.73%.
data.name: Electric Fuse
